chunks.speaker: PM (Project Director)
chunks.text: So evaluation criteria, I think that will be good, so then let's come to the finance, I have some calculations which I made for the budget.

chunks.speaker: PM (Project Director)
chunks.text: So actually, our budget was twelve point five Euro, but it's coming to nine point nine five Euro, so we are below the budget, okay, so still we are saving some money. I think it's a good figure.

chunks.speaker: ID (Industrial Designer)
chunks.text: Well, we haven't come to mine yet, so gonna have a bit of difference of opinion.

chunks.speaker: ME (Marketing Expert)
chunks.text: Cost a lot of money to market it, is it?

chunks.speaker: ID (Industrial Designer)
chunks.text: Provisionary cost analysis, we do not have an LCD display. LCD display is gonna be very expensive.

chunks.speaker: ID (Industrial Designer)
chunks.text: So if we add approximately two to three Euro per remote, now we're up around about twelve, twelve and a half as to what the company had initially requested.
chunks.task_title: Update aggregate BOM cost to €12.45 (Safety margin €0.05)

chunks.speaker: ME (Marketing Expert)
chunks.text: So that means we can put the LCD in, yeah.

chunks.speaker: ID (Industrial Designer)
chunks.text: So to come up with what the company wants is a fifty million profit, we're gonna have to go a long ways.
chunks.task_title: Compute 50M profit sales threshold and breakeven volume

chunks.speaker: PM (Project Director)
chunks.text: This we are talking about one unit, okay, so when it go into the quantity, the cost will come down.
chunks.task_title: Incorporate tiered production scale discount curve

chunks.speaker: PM (Project Director)
chunks.text: So what I will do is I will try to negotiate with the vendors to get the production cost less, so then we can save some money to put into our marketing promotions. I will look after.
